reza: Heads-up: onboarding dev hit weird combo: pnpm workspace + edge bundle -> resolved CJS + missing node: builtin + duplicate types.
mina: what error exactly?
reza: Cloudflare dev: `Error: Cannot find module 'node:buffer'` then later `The requested module '/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/index.cjs' does not provide an export named 'default'`.
jorge: classic: bundler picked CJS. Are you using a lockfile different from repo root? pnpm can create per-package node_modules when lockfile mismatch.
reza: repo uses a nested app package-lock? We had an old lockfile in the sample directory.
ivy: that would create two physical installs. Two copies = duplicated types + separate singleton instances (auth retry issue).
mina: quick triage: run `pnpm -v`, `pnpm why @redwood/sdk`, and `find node_modules -type l -maxdepth 3 -ls` to spot symlinks.
reza: pnpm 7.22.0; `pnpm why` shows hoisted at root but sample had a local node_modules symlink pointing to workspace package.
jorge: immediate workarounds: 1) delete nested lockfile and run `pnpm install` from monorepo root, 2) alias in bundler: `alias: {'@redwood/sdk': path.join(__dirname, '../node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/esm/index.mjs')}`, 3) set esbuild mainFields to `['module','browser','main']`.
mina: for the `node:` builtin error, avoid `node:` imports in edge-targeted bundle or provide small polyfills. Remove `node:buffer` usage from the SDK entry used by edge.
ivy: types dup: add root tsconfig `paths` mapping: `{"@redwood/sdk": ["./node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/index.d.ts"]}` or set `skipLibCheck: true` as temporary.
reza: added small repro to issue #971 with steps + the stray lockfile. ci-bot created the issue.
ci-bot: opened issue #971: "edge: workspace-lockfile-hoist-dup-types" and attached repro.
jorge: SDK action items: publish an explicit ESM browser entry (package.json `browser` + `import`) and produce a flattened `index.d.ts`. Also add a dev-only load-count metric: `globalThis.__rw_sdk_loads = (globalThis.__rw_sdk_loads||0)+1` and warn if >1.
mina: docs action: update quickstart to call out common workspace pitfalls: nested lockfiles, pnpm vs yarn hoisting differences, bundler mainFields, alias snippet, and tsconfig paths. Add a tiny esbuild example: `esbuild.build({ entryPoints:['app.js'], bundle:true, mainFields:['module','browser'] })`.
reza: follow-ups noted. new dev unblocked after removing the stray lockfile and using alias. thanks all :thumbsup:
